tools.name: clip_functions_summary
tools.description: Get a summary of the Clip class from the Live Object Model API documentation.

clip.description: object ID or canonical path of the clip

summary.description: This class represents a clip in Live. It can be either an audio clip or a MIDI clip in the Arrangement or Session View, depending on the track / slot it lives in. Canonical paths: live_set tracks N clip_slots M clip (Session View) or live_set tracks N arrangement_clips M (Arrangement View)
